title: Critique: the Chinese room, a program has syntax but no semantics

statements.text: Searle imagines himself in a room following a program for answering Chinese questions without understanding Chinese. Running the right program is not by itself sufficient for understanding, because formal symbol manipulations have no intentionality: they have syntax but no semantics, and whatever meaning computers seem to have is in the minds of their programmers and users.

sources.quote: In the linguistic jargon, they have only a syntax but no semantics.
Such intentionality as computers appear to have is solely in the minds of those who program them and those who use them
